present.label: Read the map
present.story: {nodeCount} corners and {edgeCount} streets. We start at {start} and want to reach {goal} in as few streets as possible.
present.formal: Graph with {nodeCount} nodes and {edgeCount} undirected edges. Find a shortest path from {start} to {goal}.

same-node.label: Already there
same-node.story: Home and the goal are the same corner, {start}. No streets are needed.

initialize.label: Start at home
initialize.story: Home, corner {start}, is 0 streets away. Put it in the queue of corners to explore from.

dequeue.label: Take the next corner
dequeue.story: Take {node} from the front of the queue. Its distance from home is {distance}. Corners still waiting: {waiting}.
dequeue.formal: corner = queue.popleft() = {node}, at distance {distance}. Remaining in the queue: {waiting}.

skip-seen.label: Already discovered
skip-seen.story: The street from {from} leads to {to}, which already has distance {known}. A route through {from} cannot be shorter, so skip it.

discover.label: Discover a corner
discover.story: {to} is new. It is one street past {from}, so its distance from home is {distance}. It joins the back of the queue.

reach-goal.label: Discover the goal
reach-goal.story: {to} is the goal, one street past {from}, so it is {distance} streets from home. BFS reaches corners in order of distance, so no shorter route exists.
reach-goal.formal: distance[{to}] = {distance}, parent[{to}] = {from}, and {to} is the goal.

found.label: Return the route
found.story: The fewest streets is {distance}. Following the notes back from {goal} gives the route {route}.
found.formal: Walk parent links back from {goal}: return ({distance}, {route}).

not-found.label: No route
not-found.story: The queue is empty and {goal} was never reached, so there is no route. Corners reachable from home: {reached}.
not-found.formal: Queue exhausted without discovering {goal}. Return None.
